notes.title: Thanks
notes.content:
Hello

We would like to thank everyone who showed interest in our Demo and took the time to leave feedback. Within the next two weeks, we will publish our roadmap. The early Demo has been removed from public access. Stay tuned for our participation in upcoming festivals. We plan to release more information about our game in the future.

~ Frenzy Blood Team ~

notes.title: Patch 01
notes.content:
Hello,

We want to thank everyone who has shown interest and downloaded our Demo!

[b]Here is our first patch[/b]:
[list]
[*]Fixed the softlock in the warehouse
[*]Stopped monsters from running away to prevent chaos
[*]Fixed a bug in the AI
[*]Fixed a bug with the cigars
[/list]
Keep your blood running!

notes.title: Next Fest June 2024
notes.content:
Hello!

Our team has decided to test our skills at the Steam Next Fest from June 10-17 and show you a demo version of our game. The game is still in the early stages of development, so there might be errors and bugs in the demo. We kindly ask you to [b]report[/b] any issues you encounter, and we will promptly fix them and communicate with you, sharing various details about the game. If you enjoy this small glimpse of our game, please add us to your [b]wishlist[/b]. This will give us confidence that we are creating an interesting product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44851172/a2b3e217325d8d4344fa8b1d774556c63d309ebe.png[/img]
Unfortunately, we didn't manage to showcase and reveal the full potential of the protagonist's madness in the [b]demo version[/b]. This feature of the game is still in the testing and improvement stage.

By the end of the festival, we will provide you with a project [b]roadmap[/b], and we hope you will join our [url=https://discord.gg/VR7HknsPGa]Discord[/url] channel for further communication and to receive the latest news about the game.

A few tips for the game:
[olist]
[*]Pay attention to the sheet on the desk in the office, which shows the placement of items on the player's body.
[*]By default, the graphics settings are not at the highest level. If your computer allows, you can go to the menu and improve the graphics quality or reduce it.
[*]A small reminder - items can be picked up from a distance with a double-click GRAB button.
[*]To move to the mission level from the office, simply burn the letter.
[/olist]
See you at the festival!
